name: Rook
description: the hero's rival climber, a tall lean damned soul with pale ash-grey skin and a long narrow face, a patched brown mountaineer's coat, a red scarf that burns at its tips without burning down, one glove, a coil of rope over one shoulder, a tarnished medal on a ribbon round his neck stamped with the number 2, always mid-stretch, smug

poses.stand: standing in profile facing right, relaxed, weight on one leg

idle.action: stands, breathes slowly, shifts weight and looks around

walk.action: walks forward unhurried, staying in the same spot in the frame

hiccup.action: flinches back, startled, then settles and nods
